lessons.title: Good Food
lessons.learn_line: What 'good food' really means, why the body needs it, and why people need different amounts.
warmup: What did you eat today? Was it good for your body?
Does everyone in your family eat the same amount of food? Why or why not?
What do you think 'nutritious' food means?
Can eating too much, even of good food, be harmful?

reading.summary_en: In this lesson, Ms Rehana, the English teacher, talks to her class about food. She explains that food is very important because we cannot live without it, so we must always eat good food. Good food means the right kind of food for good health — it is nutritious and contains the natural substances the body needs to grow properly and stay healthy. However, she warns that eating too much is bad for health, even if the food is good. A person should eat only the amount the body needs, and this amount depends on a person's growth and physical structure, so not everyone needs the same kind or quantity of food.
reading.gist_bn: এই পাঠে ইংরেজি শিক্ষক মিস রেহানা শ্রেণিতে খাবার নিয়ে কথা বলেন। তিনি বলেন, খাদ্য ছাড়া আমরা বাঁচতে পারি না, তাই সবসময় ভালো খাবার খেতে হবে। ভালো খাবার মানে সুস্বাস্থ্যের জন্য সঠিক খাবার—যা পুষ্টিকর এবং শরীরের প্রয়োজনীয় প্রাকৃতিক উপাদান ধারণ করে। তবে ভালো খাবারও বেশি খাওয়া স্বাস্থ্যের জন্য ক্ষতিকর। প্রত্যেকের বৃদ্ধি ও শারীরিক গঠন অনুযায়ী খাবারের ধরন ও পরিমাণ আলাদা হয়।

writing.prompt: Write a paragraph on 'Good Food' (about 100 words).
writing.model: Good food is the foundation of a healthy life. It means the right kind of food that keeps our body fit and strong. Such food is nutritious, which means it contains the natural substances our body needs to grow properly and to stay free from disease. However, good food alone is not enough; we must also eat the right amount. Eating too much, even of healthy food, harms the body. The quantity we need is not the same for everyone, because it depends on a person's age, growth and physical structure. By choosing good food and eating it in the right amount, we can lead a healthy and active life.

lessons.title: Kinds of Food
lessons.learn_line: The main classes of food, what each one does for the body, and which foods give us each.
warmup: How many kinds of food do you think the body needs?
Which foods give you energy to run and play?
Which foods help you build muscles and grow?
Why do doctors tell us to eat fruits and vegetables?

reading.summary_en: Foods are divided into classes according to the substances they contain. The main classes are carbohydrates, proteins, fats, and vitamins and minerals. Carbohydrates give us energy and are found in foods like rice, potatoes and sugar. Proteins help the body grow and repair itself and come from fish, meat, eggs and pulses. Fats also give energy and warmth, and butter and ghee are a good source of fat. Vitamins and minerals protect the body and keep it healthy; minerals are present in foods such as milk, and vitamins come mainly from fruits and vegetables. To stay healthy we need all of these kinds of food in the right balance.
reading.gist_bn: খাদ্যের মধ্যে থাকা উপাদান অনুযায়ী খাবারকে কয়েকটি শ্রেণিতে ভাগ করা হয়—শর্করা (কার্বোহাইড্রেট), আমিষ (প্রোটিন), চর্বি (ফ্যাট) এবং ভিটামিন ও খনিজ। কার্বোহাইড্রেট শক্তি দেয় (ভাত, আলু, চিনি)। প্রোটিন দেহ গঠন ও মেরামত করে (মাছ, মাংস, ডিম, ডাল)। চর্বি শক্তি ও উষ্ণতা দেয় (মাখন, ঘি)। ভিটামিন ও খনিজ দেহকে সুস্থ রাখে (দুধে খনিজ, ফল ও শাকসবজিতে ভিটামিন)। সুস্থ থাকতে সব ধরনের খাবারই সঠিক পরিমাণে দরকার।

writing.prompt: Write a paragraph on 'Kinds of Food' (about 100 words).

No single food can give us everything, so we should eat a balanced mix of all these kinds every day.

lessons.title: Our Daily Diet
lessons.learn_line: Which foods we should eat regularly, and why milk, fruit, vegetables and water matter every day.
warmup: What do you usually eat every single day?

reading.summary_en: In this dialogue, Ms Rehana talks with her students about the essential foods we need in our daily diet. The students say they eat rice, ruti, fish and meat every day. Ms Rehana adds that we must also eat vegetables and fruits, because they contain plenty of vitamins and minerals that keep the body free from diseases and are good for the skin and overall health. She also explains that we should drink milk every day, as it is highly rich in calcium, which helps healthy growth and makes our bones and teeth strong. Finally, she reminds them to drink pure water at regular intervals, because water is essential and we cannot live without it.
reading.gist_bn: এই কথোপকথনে মিস রেহানা শিক্ষার্থীদের সঙ্গে দৈনন্দিন খাদ্যতালিকার প্রয়োজনীয় খাবার নিয়ে আলোচনা করেন। শিক্ষার্থীরা প্রতিদিন ভাত, রুটি, মাছ ও মাংস খায়। রেহানা বলেন, শাকসবজি ও ফলও খেতে হবে—এগুলোতে প্রচুর ভিটামিন ও খনিজ থাকে যা দেহকে রোগমুক্ত রাখে এবং ত্বক ও স্বাস্থ্যের জন্য ভালো। প্রতিদিন দুধ পান করা উচিত, কারণ এতে ক্যালসিয়াম থাকে যা হাড় ও দাঁত মজবুত করে। নিয়মিত বিরতিতে বিশুদ্ধ পানি পান করতে হবে, কারণ পানি ছাড়া বাঁচা যায় না।

lessons.title: A Delicious Dish

warmup: What is your favourite home-made dish?

reading.summary_en: This lesson is a simple recipe for making a delicious fruit custard. The ingredients are one ripe banana, one apple, one small ripe papaya, two tablespoons of custard powder, half a litre of milk and four tablespoons of sugar. To prepare it, you first wash and peel the fruits, then cut them into small pieces and keep them in a bowl. Next, you boil the milk in a pot and mix in the sugar. You take the custard powder in a cup, add four tablespoons of cold milk and mix it well, then pour this mixture into the boiling milk and stir. You boil it for five minutes, stirring all the time, then take the pot off the stove and let the custard cool. Finally, you pour it into the fruit bowl, and the delicious custard is ready to eat. The lesson also teaches sequence connectors — first, then, next, after that, finally.
reading.gist_bn: এই পাঠ একটি সুস্বাদু ফ্রুট কাস্টার্ড তৈরির সহজ রেসিপি। উপকরণ: পাকা কলা ১টি, আপেল ১টি, ছোট পাকা পেঁপে ১টি, কাস্টার্ড পাউডার ২ টেবিল চামচ, দুধ আধা লিটার, চিনি ৪ টেবিল চামচ। প্রথমে ফল ধুয়ে খোসা ছাড়িয়ে ছোট টুকরো করে বাটিতে রাখো; তারপর দুধ ফুটিয়ে চিনি মেশাও; কাপে কাস্টার্ড পাউডার ও ঠান্ডা দুধ মিশিয়ে ফুটন্ত দুধে ঢেলে নাড়াও; পাঁচ মিনিট ফুটিয়ে চুলা থেকে নামাও ও ঠান্ডা করো; অবশেষে ফলের বাটিতে ঢালো—কাস্টার্ড প্রস্তুত। পাঠটি ক্রমসূচক শব্দও শেখায়—first, then, next, after that, finally।

mcqs.q: What dish does this recipe make?
mcqs.explain: The recipe makes a fruit custard.

mcqs.q: How much milk is needed?
mcqs.explain: Half a litre of milk is used.

mcqs.q: How many tablespoons of custard powder are used?
mcqs.explain: Two tablespoons of custard powder.

mcqs.q: What is the first step in preparing the custard?
mcqs.explain: First, wash and peel the fruits.

mcqs.q: The custard powder is first mixed with —
mcqs.explain: Mix the powder with four tablespoons of cold milk.

mcqs.q: How long is the mixture boiled?
mcqs.explain: Boil for five minutes, stirring all the time.

mcqs.q: What must you do while boiling the mixture?
mcqs.explain: You must stir it all the time.

mcqs.q: What is the last step?
options: pour the custard into the fruit bowl
mcqs.explain: Finally, pour it into the fruit bowl.

short_answers.q: What are the ingredients of the fruit custard?
short_answers.model: The ingredients are one ripe banana, one apple, one small ripe papaya, two tablespoons of custard powder, half a litre of milk and four tablespoons of sugar.

short_answers.q: How do you prepare the fruits?
short_answers.model: First you wash and peel the fruits. Then you cut them into small pieces and keep them in a bowl.

short_answers.q: How is the custard powder mixed?
short_answers.model: You take the custard powder in a small cup, add four tablespoons of cold milk and mix it well before pouring it into the boiling milk.

short_answers.q: What do you do after pouring the mixture into the milk?
short_answers.model: After pouring the mixture into the boiling milk, you stir it and boil it for five minutes, stirring all the time.

short_answers.q: What is the final step before serving?
short_answers.model: You take the pot off the stove, let the custard cool, and finally pour it into the fruit bowl. Then the delicious custard is ready to eat.

short_answers.q: Why are sequence connectors useful in a recipe?
short_answers.model: Sequence connectors like first, then, next, after that and finally show the correct order of the steps, so the reader knows exactly what to do and when.

summary.model: This recipe explains how to make a delicious fruit custard. First, the fruits are washed, peeled and cut into small pieces. Then the milk is boiled and sugar is mixed in. Custard powder is mixed with a little cold milk and poured into the boiling milk, which is stirred and boiled for five minutes. After that, the pot is taken off the stove and the custard is left to cool. Finally, it is poured over the fruit, and the dish is ready to eat.

writing.prompt: Describe how to make a cup of tea using these connectors: first, then, next, after that, finally.
writing.model: Making a cup of tea is quick and easy. First, pour some water into a pan and put it on the stove to boil. Then add a spoonful of tea leaves to the boiling water and let it boil for a minute. Next, pour in some milk and add sugar to taste, stirring it well. After that, let the tea boil gently for another minute so that the flavour mixes properly. Finally, strain the tea into a clean cup, and your hot, refreshing cup of tea is ready to drink.

lessons.title: The Little Plant
lessons.learn_line: How a sleeping seed wakes and grows into a plant — and what plants need to live.
warmup: Have you ever planted a seed and watched it grow?
What does a seed need before it can become a plant?
What wakes a sleeping seed under the soil?
Why do you think the poet calls the plant 'a dear little plant'?

reading.theme: The awakening and growth of new life in nature.
reading.central_idea: Deep inside a seed, a little plant lies sleeping until the sunshine and the raindrop call it to wake. Answering their call, the plant rises and grows upward to see the wonderful world outside. The poem gently shows that living things need light and water to grow, and celebrates the wonder of new life.
reading.gist_bn: একটি বীজের গভীরে একটি ছোট্ট চারাগাছ ঘুমিয়ে থাকে। সূর্যের আলো ও বৃষ্টির ফোঁটা তাকে জেগে উঠে আলোর দিকে এগিয়ে যেতে ডাকে। ডাক শুনে চারাগাছটি জেগে ওঠে এবং বাইরের সুন্দর পৃথিবী দেখতে ওপরের দিকে বেড়ে ওঠে। কবিতাটি বোঝায় যে গাছের বেড়ে উঠতে আলো ও পানি দরকার, আর নতুন প্রাণের জন্মকে এটি আনন্দের সঙ্গে তুলে ধরে।

qa.q: Where is the little plant sleeping at the start of the poem?
qa.model: At the start, the little plant is sleeping deep inside the heart of a seed, buried far down in the soil. It lies there fast asleep, waiting to grow.

qa.q: Who spoke to the little plant?
qa.model: Two voices of nature spoke to the little plant: the sunshine and the raindrop. They both called out to wake the sleeping plant.

qa.q: What did the sunshine and the raindrop want the plant to do?
qa.model: They wanted the little plant to wake up from its sleep and creep upward toward the light, in other words, to grow out of the seed and into the world above.

qa.q: What two things does a plant need in order to grow?
qa.model: The poem shows that a plant needs two things to grow: sunlight, shown by the sunshine, and water, shown by the raindrop. With light and water, the seed can sprout and grow.

qa.q: What did the little plant do after it heard the voices?
qa.model: After hearing the voices of the sunshine and the raindrop, the little plant woke up and rose upward. It grew out of the seed to see the wonderful world outside.

qa.q: How does the poem connect growth with the wonder of life?
qa.model: The poem treats the growth of a tiny seed as something magical. The plant 'rose to see' a 'wonderful' world, suggesting that even the smallest new life is full of wonder, and that growth means reaching out toward light and discovery.

qa.q: Which word in the poem suggests the plant began to grow?
qa.model: The word 'rose' (from 'rise') suggests the plant began to grow, because it rose upward out of the seed toward the light.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph on 'How a Plant Grows' (about 80 words).
writing.model: Every big tree begins as a tiny seed. When a seed is buried in the soil and given water and warmth, the little plant inside it begins to wake. Soon it sends out a tiny root downward and a green shoot, or sprout, upward toward the sunlight. As the sunshine and the raindrops feed it, the plant grows taller and stronger, putting out leaves and branches. In this quiet, wonderful way, a small sleeping seed turns into a living, growing plant.
